blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has extended the deadline until Oct. 31 for online businesses to comply with the requirement to display their registration seal badge on their online platforms. The extension is provided under Revenue Memorandum Circular (RMC) No. 99-2026, which applies to online sellers, merchants, and persons selling goods or services through digital or electronic platforms, including those with an online business presence. The extension is intended to give covered taxpayers sufficient time to secure and properly display their badge as proof of registration.
